caseName: Richard v. Dist. Attorney of Westmoreland Cnty.
caseNameFull: Thomas P. RICHARD, Sr. v. DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF WESTMORELAND COUNTY, PENNSYLVANIA

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States *866Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
